description: Wireless Village at DEF CON 24 explores radio frequency security, software-defined radio, Wi-Fi exploitation, Bluetooth Low Energy hacking, and wireless CTF challenges.

talks.title: Village People - Wireless Capture the Flag Inbrief
talks.teaser: An introductory briefing to the DEF CON 24 Wireless Capture the Flag (WCTF), explaining contest rules, scoring, and frequency challenges.

talks.title: Village People
talks.teaser: Day 2 kickoff and briefing for the DEF CON 24 Wireless Capture the Flag competition, detailing new challenges and current scoreboard standing.

talks.title: Matt Knight - Reversting LoRa Deconstructing a Next Gen Proprietary LP
talks.teaser: Reverse engineering the proprietary LoRa PHY modulation layer, deconstructing chirp spread spectrum encoding and packet structures.

talks.title: Iyer and Nandedkar - Covert Cupid Under 11 Veil Approach for Covert
talks.teaser: Exploring 802.11 physical and MAC layer covert channels to transmit exfiltrated data under the radar of standard wireless monitoring.

talks.title: Kat Sweet - I Amateur Radio And So Can You
talks.teaser: A beginner-friendly guide to amateur radio licensing, equipment essentials, antenna fundamentals, and emergency communications for hackers.

talks.title: Jose Gutierrez and Ben Ramsey - How Do I BLE Hacking
talks.teaser: A practical introduction to Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) security assessments, sniffing toolsets, GATT service enumeration, and replay attacks.

talks.title: Gabriel Ryan
talks.teaser: Demonstrating how to construct and coordinate automated rogue Wi-Fi access points using inexpensive hardware and custom Python tooling.

talks.title: Caleb Mays and Ben Ramsey
talks.teaser: Auditing Insteon home automation wireless protocols, uncovering unauthenticated command injection and device takeover vulnerabilities.

talks.title: Brian Butterly and Stefan Kiese - Introducing the HackMeRF
talks.teaser: Introducing HackMeRF, an interactive hardware and RF training platform designed to teach software-defined radio concepts and signals analysis.

talks.title: Balint Seeber - SDR Tips and Tricks
talks.teaser: SDR expert Balint Seeber shares advanced tips, workflow optimizations, and signal exploration techniques using GNU Radio and hardware radios.
